overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, specialized academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His audience shows high engagement with posts regarding research milestones, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), hiring opportunities, and publications in computational social science and disinformation studies.

contentThemes.description: Updates on published academic papers, grants awarded, and computational methodologies for studying coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Product updates for research tools like CooRnet v2.0 for link sharing detection.
Job openings for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in data science and computational social science.
Promotional and reflective updates on upcoming presentations (e.g., #DisinfoConf2025) and methodological discussions.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing Bluesky research announcements to LinkedIn to leverage its larger audience base of 1,850 followers.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and Bluesky by initiating interactive discussions or sharing threads on methodological insights.
Include direct links and calls to action (e.g., paper preprints or job application links) directly in posts to drive external traffic.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest engagement rate (~6.14%), driven by strong repost activity on new paper announcements and student recruitment opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields consistent niche engagement among academic peers, particularly regarding tool releases like CooRnet, though with slightly lower overall interaction volume.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute volume of interactions (likes and comments) due to a larger follower count, particularly on major professional milestones such as research grant awards.
